flyer.justification: The flyer adheres well to formatting constraints though the title is 7 words long instead of at most 6 words.

summary.justification: The summary adheres strictly to all executive brief requirements, including under 400 words, TL;DR, discussion points, and action items.

instagram.justification: Follows all Instagram formatting requirements including hook, visual cues, short lines with emojis, CTA, and 12 hashtags.

linkedin.justification: The post adopts a first-person speaker persona and is missing the required 3-5 hashtags entirely.

newsletter.justification: The subject line is 51 characters long (exceeding the under 50 characters limit), but otherwise adheres well to the newsletter format.

blog.justification: The article is missing the required numbered sections and comparison/takeaway table, and mixes authorial voice with the original speaker's first-person perspective.
